THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
126
STUDY 171
Fuzzy Green Cardigan & Denim Maxi
Rights check
Source: 25052.jpg
Cozy, textured, edgy
WORKING NOTES
- The fuzzy shawl collar and denim slit skirt are the
signature details.
- Keep the concrete wall for an industrial, gritty backdrop.
Try this: Keep the concrete wall for an industrial backdrop.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight dark brown hair and a small hair
clip stands with her arms folded against
a gray concrete wall. She wears a sage
green ribbed knit crop top with a fuzzy
faux-fur shawl collar and cuffs. A
distressed dark wash denim maxi skirt
with a front slit and frayed hem sits low,
with a black belt and a silver buckle.
Black pointed-toe ankle boots with
buckle straps complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even
light. Palette of sage, faded denim, and
charcoal. Cozy and textured, in the style
of an autumn street-style editorial.
